article.title: Belgium: Massive anti-fascist protest in Brussels
article.author: teleSUR Desk
article.content: The young people, among whom there are also teachers and trade unionists, according to the Belga news agency, began a march peacefully towards Brussels South station in the middle of the morning and followed by a large police deployment. The post Belgium: Massive anti-fascist protest in Brussels appeared first on MR Online .
